narr: Heavy rain sat over a sections of Calcasieu, Vermilion, Cameron, and Jefferson Davis parishes during the early morning hours of the 28th.
ev: Several roads including Lincoln, Gauthier, and Tom Hebert were flooded southeast of Lake Charles with Black Bayou rising out of its banks at Lincoln Road. KLCH radar estimated 6 to 12 inches fell during the night across portions of southeast Calcasieu Parish.
lsr: Site at Black Bayou and E Lincoln Rd indicated the bayou reached flood stage.
NWS Employee reports water over portions of Gauthier Road.
